images.slide_text: Where I plan to make millions
Look at the size of this / 700B / In around three weeks. Bitcoin fell around 25% in a month.
Pieverse, called early / 14X / I called it at around a 65 million dollar market cap. It went on to touch a 1 billion dollar cap.
EVAA, swing traded / 13X / From 51 cents on October 27 to 6.60 dollars on November 21.
The plan is the loop / Take profits on the way up, split them across the next 10 plays, then do it again.
Why 2028? / I think we start flying in 2027 once rates come down, so the loop gets two full years.
